sources.fact: Current authoritative Brownfield entity is LBBD91/DI at 53-135 Roxwell Road.
Current Brownfield record carries 46 minimum and maximum net dwellings on 0.58ha.
Current Brownfield record is permissioned with full planning permission date 10 July 2020.
Ownership-status is owned-by-a-public-authority; this category is not a title number or exact proprietor relation.
The record supplies a point and blank geometry, not an exact application red-line or HMLR polygon.
Planning-history links to Be First application id 18537.
23 March 2020 Planning Committee considered 19/01920/FUL at 53-135 Roxwell Road and 2-4 Stebbing Way for 87 Class C3 homes.
Committee minutes state the 87-home proposal would provide 100% affordable units.
Committee delegated grant subject to completion of a Unilateral Undertaking under section 106; the committee resolution is preserved as scoped decision evidence.
13 September 2021 committee material identifies 19/01920/FUL as the permission underlying a Section 73 variation for the 87-home scheme.
The 87-home application includes 2-4 Stebbing Way while the current Brownfield site address is 53-135 Roxwell Road; 46 and 87 are not automatically substituted or added.
No exact HMLR title-to-Brownfield/application topology is established by the Brownfield point, ownership category or application address alone.

examples.result: 87 is not used to overwrite the narrower current Brownfield capacity without exact site topology.
Public-authority ownership category is not converted into an HMLR proprietor/title.
Section 73 evidence confirms the broader permission chain, not exact DI parcel identity.
Point geometry is not treated as an application or title polygon.
Promotion remains zero until exact parcel/title relation and executed overlays are verified.
